body:
[UrlProtocol PR](https://github.com/CodexCoder21Organization/UrlProtocol/pull/992) needs host shutdown to complete when a full native event-loop queue rejects close work. Its review found that a failed listener close skipped upstream acceptor-group cleanup; expanded coverage then found a second gap: an outbound QUIC UDP parent remained open and registered after its own event loop terminated.

F93b is addressing [R93a's three findings and five coverage gaps](https://github.com/CodexCoder21Organization/jvm-libp2p/blob/996be90fb23040717da7974bbec39aa5443d9b98/evidence/R93a/review.md). **Not ready: the native rejection path remains open and no corrected snapshot has been published.**

Each transport now keeps one private shutdown completion and returns independent observer futures. Repeated shutdown retains the first outcome and cannot start UDP-parent close before the original child-close operations settle. Reporting collects all individual channel, parent and group outcomes; secondary errors are suppressed, or retained in an aggregate when the original exception disables suppression. A UDP-parent shutdown hook repairs the graceful already-terminated-loop reproducer, but does not satisfy every native-rejection path.

F93b validation at `b7eecc3a0498f829088fa35a083790bb24199bc2`:
- Targeted register: **27/27 first-attempt passes**, comprising the original 18 PR cases and 9 F93b cases; zero skips and retries. This uses the native JUnit console with retries unavailable, fresh source overlays and the byte-verified snapshot45 base, not a full Gradle build.
- Repeated shutdown: red **0/4**, green **4/4**, removed-fix red **0/4**.
- Simultaneous child/parent failures: red **1/2**, green **2/2**, removed-fix red **1/2** (parent-only control passes).
- Suppression-disabled neighbor: red **1/2**, green **2/2**.
- Graceful terminated-loop case: red **0/1**, green **1/1**, removed-fix red **0/1**.
- Remaining counterexamples: native rejection **0/1** on physical-parent completion; direct native-close diagnostic **0/1** on deregistration; shutdown from an in-flight dial visitor **0/1** on late publication.
- The required 30x register has **not run**. Final-head Actions XML has **not been inspected**. Both independent full-scope review passes remain unfinished; targeted checks do not replace them.

Coverage gap 1 (settled and overlapping repeated shutdown) is covered. Gap 2 is partial: child/parent and suppression-disabled reporting are tested, but multiple-child/group failure coverage remains. Gap 3 is partial and has an unfixed native rejection counterexample. Gap 4 has a failing public dial-publication reproducer in evidence. Gap 5 (large inventory and long-lived churn) remains unfinished.

Default branch is unchanged `develop` [436997d5e5f5b80f1503504b19e5b813654a3a49](https://github.com/CodexCoder21Organization/jvm-libp2p/commit/436997d5e5f5b80f1503504b19e5b813654a3a49), with no equivalent cleanup. **Existing default-branch test edits: none. Existing PR-added test edits: none.** All F93b product tests are new files.

Already published: `community.kotlin.libp2p:jvm-libp2p:1.3.0-codexcoder21-snapshot-45`, built from [e3e5caf4a0d5cfc1acd40be2ec7468078ce9f8fe](https://github.com/CodexCoder21Organization/jvm-libp2p/commit/e3e5caf4a0d5cfc1acd40be2ec7468078ce9f8fe). Local and downloaded JAR SHA-256: `a2c9e25b16c69d83bdd813648c447d74bf549ec9a5eaad83cdb51c53a3b19a2c`; all 1,107 entries and POM bytes verified in [FLIBP8 publication evidence](https://github.com/CodexCoder21Organization/jvm-libp2p/tree/ebcb5f2d737554c506bab6c070ba33a4c6c09b0e/evidence/FLIBP8). Snapshot45 has not been overwritten. **F93b published no artifact.**

[F93b evidence](https://github.com/CodexCoder21Organization/jvm-libp2p/tree/wip/F93b-evidence-20261105/evidence/F93b) contains exact first-attempt XML, failing public tests and the [remaining native boundary](https://github.com/CodexCoder21Organization/jvm-libp2p/blob/wip/F93b-evidence-20261105/evidence/F93b/native-boundary.md). Native deregistration queues its state update onto the rejecting executor; even direct physical close leaves registration pending. Completing that correction appears to require an upstream Netty change and another dependency artifact, which this lane is not authorized to publish. The brief's stop-if-a-rule-must-be-broken clause is the reason publication is blocked.

No merge, enqueue, close, deployment, check re-request or handoff-cli action was performed.
